expected_inputs.name: run
expected_inputs.meaning: The run the engineer wants resolved (for example R-100).

expected_inputs.name: spacing-limit
expected_inputs.meaning: The spacing limit to examine against.

expected_inputs.name: supports-table
expected_inputs.meaning: The current supports on the run.
expected_inputs.basis_requirement: A complete five-element read basis (C §5.1) and per-row subject content identities (C §5.3).

required_tools.name: read-supports
required_tools.purpose: Read the supports on the run.

required_tools.name: examine-spacing
required_tools.purpose: Examine the support spacing against the limit (the agent's A3 findings).

required_tools.name: host-spacing-check
required_tools.purpose: Run the host's named support-spacing check.
required_tools.fallback: Examination only; report "host check not run".

checkpoints.name: CP-accept
checkpoints.scope: Per change item; one A5 may list several items.
checkpoints.purpose: The engineer decides whether each support change goes into the model.

on_negative_decision.explanation: All items rejected: return to Propose once with the engineer's reason, otherwise stop.

on_mixed_decision.branch: Continue with the accepted items and report the rejected ones.

expected_act_evidence.description: The host's act record of A5 or A10 per item (OP-C7, OP-C8 capture) with its capture-evidence reference.

checkpoints.name: CP-check
checkpoints.scope: The objects the applied items created or changed.
checkpoints.purpose: The engineer records their own checking of the changed supports.

expected_act_evidence.description: The host's act record of A4 per object (OP-C6 capture) with its capture-evidence reference, bound to each object's post-application subject content identity. An earlier A4 counts while that content is current, cited with its time (WD I-8).

returned_outputs.name: adjustment
returned_outputs.destination: Host supports table, through the host's proposal route.

returned_outputs.name: examination-report
returned_outputs.meaning: Spacing findings after application, citing the OP-C3 results and the OP-C1 basis by reference.

returned_outputs.name: host-check-result
returned_outputs.meaning: The host's named spacing check, before and after, by reference (optional; produced only where the host offers the check).
returned_outputs.destination: The conversation; the result itself stays in the host results view.
promised_standing: as the host states it: host checks passed: support spacing, or host check failed: support spacing, each with its evaluated basis

returned_outputs.name: checked-rows
returned_outputs.meaning: The engineer's A4 on the changed rows.
promised_standing: marked checked by the person, conditional on CP-check; shown lapsed for affected rows after a lapse (WD I-4)

returned_outputs.name: summary
returned_outputs.meaning: What changed, which acts the engineer performed, and what is unknown.

returned_evidence.name: EV-basis
returned_evidence.meaning: The relied-on read basis (for example B1, B2).

returned_evidence.name: EV-receipt
returned_evidence.meaning: The host receipt per applied item, as a link, not a copy.

returned_evidence.name: EV-exam
returned_evidence.meaning: The OP-C3 result (A3 findings) with its evaluated basis.

returned_evidence.name: EV-host-check
returned_evidence.meaning: The OP-C12 result with its evaluated basis (T4a).

returned_evidence.name: EV-accept-act
returned_evidence.meaning: Human-act records, A5 or A10 per item, with capture-evidence references.

returned_evidence.name: EV-checked-act
returned_evidence.meaning: Human-act records, A4 per object, with capture-evidence references.
